rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood lands — 8+/10 per teaching beat; below 7 = REVISE.
rules_evaluated.evidence: trace.phases[0].mood_score=8, trace.close.mood_score=8. Single teaching phase (lecture has no ## Phase headers; two prose paragraphs = two slides). Both the arc-recognition beat (Para 1) and the spec-and-tests-to-grounding reframe (Para 2) are TEACHING beats (naming a discipline, landing a reframe) — mood-floor applies — and both clear 8. No mechanical setup beat present to exempt.

Closing question ('How do you know it's right?') is open, not accusatory — the persona in trace.phases[0].persona_action reads it as 'a real question; I don't have a tidy answer and the lecture doesn't hand me one,' not as a rebuke. Para 2's implicit failure mode (shipping at scale without grounding) surfaces only as the unresolved close, never as 'you did this wrong.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture opens 'The quality arc ran the whole training' — a positive discipline named first. 'Grounding' is introduced as a positive extension of that discipline, not framed against a named failure (fabrication/hallucination/violation language is absent throughout).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity — CONSOLIDATES front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, and mood-doesn't-resolve-early into one verdict.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea fidelity: M6's Big Idea (strategy doc line 4, spot-gaps-build-the-loop-module) is 'two runs... are enough evidence to name what the three-pattern didn't anticipate... author a session-shaper skill'; Para 1's 'Today adds the fifth move: a second skill, packaged from what two runs taught, in the shape the dominant gap calls for' matches this without pre-empting the specific routing logic (memory/verifier/skill) that the exercise itself teaches. Module-to-module arc: the unresolved close hands cleanly into `exercises/spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md`, the next include in the module file's `## Start here` sequence — no other module's teaching moment (M7 deliberation, `the-loop-has-a-name`'s eval-naming) is pulled forward. Front-run check: 'grounding' and 'signal' stay at the vocabulary this lecture owns; the eval/verifier/judge/gate naming that `the-loop-has-a-name.md` owns as M6's closer is not used here. Mood-doesn't-resolve-early: the closing question is explicitly left open per the maintainer's own watch-for ('Let it sit. Don't answer it for the room') and the exercise, not this lecture, is where the diagnostic work happens.

The closing question is a rhetorical/epistemic hand-off to the exercise, not a cohort-management instruction. Body is narrative/teaching register throughout both paragraphs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Meta-frame lectures = closers, not openers. Placement diagnostic: naming a pattern (closer), showing a ceiling (opener), or teaching vocabulary (mid-module)?
rules_evaluated.evidence: Para 1 narrates a pattern already lived (M1 tests-first -> M2 plan push-back -> M3 skill -> M5 verifier) in exactly the closer-shaped register the rule targets ('naming a pattern... recognition of pattern made visible'). It is placed as the OPENER, immediately before the M6 exercise (module file `## Start here`: the-2-frontiers -> story-of-module-6 -> quality-is-grounding -> exercise). Sibling comparison inside this same module: `the-map-filled-in.md` does the same kind of work (arc consolidation, explicitly self-labeled in its own maintainer block as 'Consolidation and recognition, NOT new teaching (check_lectures §1)') and IS placed at M6's close, after the exercise and Debrief. The two arc-consolidation lectures in the same module take opposite placements under the same rule. Mitigating factor: the M1-M5 material named IS already lived by the time the student reads this (M6), so 'told after [those] exercises' is technically satisfied for that portion; only the one forward-looking clause ('Today adds the fifth move... a second skill') is told before M6's own exercise, and it stays general (no specific gap-routing given away).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either move the arc-recognition content (Para 1) to sit after the exercise (e.g. folded into the Human close alongside `the-map-filled-in.md`, which already does this work at the same module), or keep it as opener but recast Para 1 from a module-by-module recitation into a forward ceiling-statement ('you're about to add a fifth move to a discipline already in your hands') rather than a five-item retrospective list.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule targets contrast-mood modules (M5-style: learn through doing, name it after). M6's mood contract is practitioner fluency (leverage/stakes-setting register, per strategy doc line 443), not contrast/unease. This lecture precedes M6's exercise, which is not a contrast-mood exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No cross-module sequencing in lecture bodies. Carve-out: arc lectures whose SUBJECT is the arc keep module ranges.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body names M1/M2/M3/M5 in Para 1. Independently verified the carve-out applies: this lecture's entire subject is the cross-module quality arc itself (the file title is literally 'Quality is grounding' / 'Five moves, one quality discipline'), not a bridge or forward-reference to a specific downstream module beat. All refs are backward-looking material about moves already completed; no forward module-numbered sequencing appears above the maintainer fence (the M7 mention lives below it). Matches the file's own maintainer-logged section-3 sweep (2026-07-02: 5 refs judged, 0 fixed, 5 carve-out).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide/lecture headers pass the squint test AND the truth clause.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Two headers, both claim-shaped and distinct: 'Five moves, one quality discipline' (squint: names the concept — five prior moves compose one discipline; truth: body lists exactly five named moves and states 'That's the quality kit you walk out with'). 'From spec-and-tests to grounding' (squint: names the pivot itself; truth: body narrates spec-and-tests as the recurring theme, then 'The discipline has gone deeper since... grounding'). No empty containers, no orphan mood headers, no duplicate headers.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Mechanically verified: `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/quality-is-grounding.md` reports 2 slides, 0 oversized, against the 210-word/6-bullet limits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: (Whole-compendium N/A note, not a per-rule finding.) check_prompts.md governs fenced **Prompt** blocks a student copies.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File carries zero fenced code blocks / **Prompt** labels — it is a read-aloud stakes-setter lecture with no student-copied content. check_prompts.md's 44 per-prompt design rules (placeholders, lead-ins, chaining, session-reset, etc.) have no attachment surface anywhere in this file. The compendium's other firing condition — (b) surfacing audit BLOCK findings to the maintainer per one-at-a-time priority-ordered cards, rule 26 — governs this judge's own output behavior when presenting findings in chat, not a property of the target file, and is honored structurally by this fixed-schema JSON report rather than by a separate row per numbered rule.

teaching_moment_lands.note: The spec-and-tests -> grounding reframe lands reliably for a persona 2 weeks into Claude Code who has lived M1-M5 and holds the actual artefacts (skill file, verifier) Para 1 names — recognition is concrete (own files), not abstract praise, so the moment survives reasonable persona-skill variation. Delivery-dependent risk noted: if Para 1 is read as a flat module-by-module list rather than voiced as 'all five are one discipline' (per the file's own watch-for), it drifts toward this module's own named mood-stealing failure shape, 'trainer-monologue retrospective' (named in `spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md`'s Meta block). Captured as the fix_hint on check_lectures rule_index 1 rather than a blocking failure — the risk is in execution, not in the text as written, and the maintainer block already carries a delivery watch-for addressing it.
